warning.untypedNumeric: This answer compares values that are saved as text, not as numbers — so a maximum, minimum or ranking here can be wrong. Open that dataset, choose “Revise the design”, tell the AI that this column is numeric, and rebuild it.
warning.untypedNumericTech: SPARQL compares untyped values as strings ("9.4" > "100.0"). Variable: {{variable}}. To handle it in the query itself, cast with xsd:double({{variable}}).
